items.headline: ALB vs. SQM: Which Lithium Stock Should You Bet on Now?
items.snippet: Zacks comparison: ALB favored over SQM on higher earnings growth projections and lower leverage; both benefit from EV/ESS lithium demand growth of 10-20% CAGR 2025-2030.

items.headline: Lithium price 'chill' returns, JPMorgan downgrades Albemarle (ALB.US) earnings forecast and cuts target price to $140
items.snippet: JPMorgan cuts ALB target to $140; Greenbushes CGP3 fire delays full production to Q1 2027; valuation seen as reasonable for volatile lithium producer.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Lithium demand up 45% YoY through May driven by stationary storage; raised 2026/2030 demand forecasts; CGP3 fire recovery targeted Q1 2027; ~$100M run-rate cost productivity gains YTD.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC Capital Markets outperform rating on ALB, price target cut to $157 from $166; demand growth outpacing supply despite Q2 lithium price softness.
